title: Network Architecture
subtopics: OSI seven layers: Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application
TCP/IP four layers: Network Access, Internet, Transport, Application

definitions.definition: Ensures communication between two consecutive layers
Functionality provided by a layer to the layer above
Rules and conventions through which communication takes place at the same layer level
Protocol Data Unit – the unit of data passed between peer entities
Each layer adds its own header/trailer to the data unit from the layer above

learning_objectives: Describe the layered architecture principle and its advantages
Name and explain all seven OSI layers and their functions
Map OSI layers to the TCP/IP model
